verdicts.reason: A: the missing-asset placeholder collides with the SOLSTICE logo. 'Solstice presents' sits below the headline, so the reading order is backwards. The tagline is squeezed into a 6-line column with ragged wrapping. The RSVP button is no bigger than the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS chips in a 2x2 grid, which buries the CTA.
